findings.claim: 3.02 disk includes GFABASV3.PRG explicitly marked Version 3.02; GFABASIC.PRG is internally marked GFA BASIC V 2.0 US; GFABASRO.PRG identifies GFA BASIC 2.0.
GFACOM17 reports zero decoded instructions and zero covered bytes in rg-dis CPU view; its compiler relation to GFA_BCOM is INDETERMINATE.
MAKE_NDX, DEF2DFN and RCS2 are exact cross-distribution duplicates in 3.6 and 3.6TT.
The 3.6 and 3.6TT main interpreters have strong structural continuity.
No emulator-based behavior comparisons were performed.
